landing.closingBody: Khetha umntu oyintsomi uze uphonononge. Akukho kubhalisa, akukho nto iphuma kwibhrawuza yakho.

bank.a: Hayi. I-Tengo yi-app yovavanyo eqikelela ukuba imali yakho ihlala ixesha elingakanani. Ayigcini mali, ayibolekisi, ayithengisi mveliso kwaye ayiniki ngcebiso yezemali.

data.a: Njengondwendwe, iinkcukacha zakho zihlala kule bhrawuza kwisixhobo sakho kwaye akukho nto ithunyelwa ku-Tengo. Nabani na osebenzisa le bhrawuza angazivula, ngoko sebenzisa ukutshixa nge-PIN kwifowuni ekwabelwana ngayo. I-akhawunti yeyokuzikhethela; igcina iinkcukacha zakho ngumboneleli wovimba weenkcukacha okhankanywe kwisaziso sobumfihlo.

cost.a: Akukho nto. I-Tengo isimahla ngexesha lovavanyo, akukho kubhalisa kufunekayo.

wrong.a: Luqikelelo oluvela kwimbali yakho, ngoko lusenokungalungi. Vula u-Kutheni lo mhla ukuze ubone okufakiweyo, lungisa nayiphi na intengiselwano ku-Imali, okanye usebenzise u-Buza ngesi siphumo ukuze ucele ukujongwa. Kule demo eso sicelo siyalinganiswa kwaye sihlala kwisixhobo sakho.

landing.previewAlt: Tengo Ekhaya: umhla kaLerato, uhlahlo lwemihla ngemihla nemali elandelayo. Umntu oyintsomi.

why.title: Kutheni lo mhla
why.plain: Siqala ngebhalansi yakho yanamhlanje, sisuse iintlawulo ngemihla yazo, size sisebenzise ngomlinganiselo wakho wesiqhelo wemihla ngemihla de imali ifike kuziro. Olo suku ngumhla wakho. Imali ongekayifumani ayibalwa.

rule.enough: Nkqu neveki enzima ihlala kude kufike imali elandelayo enokufika emva kwexesha kakhulu.
rule.tight: Iveki eqhelekileyo ihlala kude kufike imali elandelayo yesiqhelo. Iveki enzima ayihlali.
rule.short: Iveki eqhelekileyo iyaphela phambi kwemali elandelayo yesiqhelo.
rule.unclear: Imbali ayanelanga okanye akukho ngeniso, ngoko akukabikho mhla.

me.title: Mna
me.nameBody: I-Tengo ivela kwigama elithi mutengo, igama lesiTshivenda elithetha ixabiso. Le ntsingiselo inikwe ngumseki kwaye isaza kuqinisekiswa sisithethi sesiTshivenda.

how.1: Yahlula imbali yakho ibe yingeniso, iintlawulo eziqhelekileyo nenkcitho yemihla ngemihla.
how.2: Ibala inkcitho yakho yesiqhelo yemihla ngemihla kwiintsuku ezingama-60 zokugqibela, kunye neveki elula neveki enzima.
how.3: Ifumanisa ukuba imali yakho elandelayo idla ngokungena nini nokuba idla ngokuba yimalini.
how.4: Ihlisa ibhalansi yakho usuku ngosuku, isusa iintlawulo ngemihla yazo, ide ifike kuziro. Olo suku ngumhla wakho.
how.5: Ithelekisa loo mhla nemali yakho elandelayo ukuze imisele imeko yakho: Yanele, Iqinile okanye Iyasilela.

plan.roomToLendHintNoReserve: Ukuboleka okanye ukunika ukuya kuthi ga kweli xabiso kukugcina ku-{{state}}.
plan.roomToLendNone: Nasiphi na isixa ngoku sinokukuhlisela ngaphantsi kuka-{{state}} okanye sisebenzise imali egcinelwe iintlawulo.
plan.roomToLendShort: Sele uyasilela phambi kwemali yakho elandelayo. Nasiphi na isixa osibolekayo sisondeza umhla wakho.
plan.lendCaution: Boleka kuphela oko unokuphila ngaphandle kokukubuyiselwa. I-Tengo ayinakuxela ukuba kuya kubuya na okanye nini.
plan.roomToLendUnsure: I-Tengo ayiqinisekanga ngokwaneleyo ngemali yakho engenayo ukuze icebise isixa. Jonga isiphumo sesixa esithile ngezantsi.
plan.notAdvice: Uqikelelo oluvela kwimbali yakho, ayilocebiso. Akukho nto apha isisigqibo sokuboleka okanye isithembiso setyala.

money.title: Imali
money.lead: Yonke intengiselwano esetyenziswa yi-Tengo, neentlawulo eziyifumeneyo.
money.emptyBodyNone: Akukabikho ntengiselwano. Ngenisa ingxelo ukuze uqale.
money.billsRule: Inkcazelo efanayo nesixa esifanayo, malunga nenyanga phakathi.
money.importBody: Layisha ingxelo yebhanki ye-CSV. Ifundwa kwesi sixhobo kwaye ithatha indawo yembali yalo mntu.
money.movableHint: Phawula intlawulo kuphela ukuba ingahlawulwa emva kwexesha ngeentsuku ezimbalwa ngaphandle kwemali yesohlwayo.
money.protectedBill: Ayisoze icetyiswe ukuba ishenxiswe: ukuhlawula emva kwexesha kunokubiza iifizi, ukhuseleko okanye ityala.

import.title: Ngenisa ingxelo
import.lead: Sebenzisa ingxelo yebhanki ye-CSV ukuze uthathe indawo yembali yalo mntu. Ayisoze iphume kwibhrawuza yakho.
import.local: Iqhutyelwa kwisixhobo sakho. Akukho nto iphuma kwibhrawuza yakho.
import.formatBody: Umhla, inkcazelo nesixa (esingaphantsi kweziro kwimali ephumayo), okanye iikholam ezahlukeneyo ze-debit ne-credit. Ubuncinane iintsuku ezili-14.
import.empty: Khetha ifayile okanye usebenzise ingxelo engumzekelo ukuze ubone imbonakalo apha.
import.mappingHint: Sizicingele ezi kwizihloko. Tshintsha nayiphi na ebonakala ingalunganga.
import.needMapping: Khetha umhla, inkcazelo, kunye nesixa okanye iikholam ze-debit ne-credit.
import.skipped_one: Kutsitywe umqolo o-{{count}} kuba umhla, inkcazelo okanye isixa asikwazanga kufundwa.
import.skipped_other: Kutsitywe imiqolo e-{{count}} kuba umhla, inkcazelo okanye isixa asikwazanga kufundwa.
import.tooShort: Le ngxelo ibandakanya iintsuku ezi-{{count}}. I-Tengo ifuna ubuncinane ezili-14.
import.noRows: Akukho miqolo isebenzisekayo ifunyenweyo ngezi kholam.
import.wideRange: Iintsuku ezi-{{count}} kuphela zembali. Uqikelelo luza kusebenza, kodwa uluhlu luza kuba lubanzi.
import.shifted_one: Imihla ishukunyiselwe phambili ngosuku olu-{{count}} ukuze ingxelo iphele izolo.
import.shifted_other: Imihla ishukunyiselwe phambili ngeentsuku ezi-{{count}} ukuze ingxelo iphele izolo.
import.balanceFromFile: Ithathwe kwibhalansi yokugqibela kwifayile: {{amount}}. Chwetheza ukuze uyitshintshe.
import.balanceKept: Akukho kholam yebhalansi. Kugcinwa ibhalansi yangoku ye-{{amount}}. Chwetheza ukuze uyitshintshe.
import.confirm: Faka imbali entsha uze ubone umhla wam
import.replaceNote: Oku kuthatha indawo yembali yalo mntu kwesi sixhobo kwaye kongeza ungeniso kubhalo lokuphicotha.
import.tooBig: Loo fayile inkulu kune-2 MB, nto leyo engaphezu kwento efunwa yingxelo. Khetha ixesha elifutshane okanye ifayile encinci.

edit.title: Hlela intengiselwano
edit.auditNote: Ukugcina kongeza ungeniso kubhalo lwakho lokuphicotha.
edit.oneOffHint: Ishiyiwe ngaphandle kwepateni yakho yesiqhelo yenkcitho nengeniso. Isabalwa kwibhalansi yakho.

audit.bill_answered: Kuphendulwe umbuzo malunga nentlawulo ebibonakala ingahlawulwanga
audit.plan_settings: Kutshintshwe inkcitho enokuncitshiswa okanye iintlawulo ezinokushenxiswa

inbox.title: Imiyalezo
inbox.lead: Umyalezo wemihla ngemihla i-Tengo ebiya kuwuthumela.
inbox.offBody: Uvale imiyalezo yemihla ngemihla, ngoko akukho nto inokuboniswa kwangaphambili. Yivule apha okanye ku-Ubumfihlo.

facts.what: Umhla wakho, imeko nohlahlo lwemihla ngemihla kuphela.
facts.never: Ayisoze ibe yibhalansi yakho okanye iintengiselwano zakho.
facts.stop: Umyalezo ngamnye uthi uvela ku-Tengo nokuba ungayimisa njani. Ungavala imiyalezo kwakhona ku-Ubumfihlo.
facts.where: Imiyalezo ye-WhatsApp ibiya kudlula ku-Meta, ngaphandle koMzantsi Afrika. I-SMS yenye indlela. Kuyalinganiswa apha: akukho nto ithunyelwayo.

whatsapp.short_other: Imali yakho isenokuphela ngo-*{{date}}*, iintsuku ezi-{{count}} phambi kwemali yakho elandelayo. Imeko: {{state}}.

help.title: Okona kunceda kakhulu
help.moveBill: Ukuba i-{{name}} ({{amount}}) ingahlawulwa emva ko-{{date}} ngaphandle kwemali yesohlwayo, oko kodwa kufikelela ku-{{state}}.
help.setAside: Ungabeka ecaleni ukuya kuthi ga kwi-{{amount}} namhlanje kwaye uhlale ku-Yanele kude kufike imali yakho elandelayo. Esi sisithuba esifanayo nesithi Isithuba sokuboleka, hayi esongezelelweyo.
help.coveredBody: Imali yakho kufuneka ihlale kude kufike imali yakho elandelayo, nkqu nakwiveki enzima ngakumbi.
help.earn: Fumana okanye wamkele i-{{amount}} engakumbi phambi ko-{{date}}, umzekelo umsebenzi owongezelelweyo okanye imali otyalwa yona.
help.earnAssume: Kucingelwa ukuba inkcitho yakho ihlala njengesiqhelo. Ukuboleka ukuze uvale isithuba kudla ngokubiza ngakumbi kamva.
help.trim: Chitha malunga ne-{{amount}} ngosuku ngaphantsi ku-{{groups}} kude kube ngu-{{date}}.
help.trimAssume: Inkcitho kuphela oyiphawule njengenokuncitshiswa. Kucingelwa ukuba yonke enye into ihlala njengesiqhelo.
help.trimPartial: Leyo yinkcitho yonke oyiphawule njengenokuncitshiswa, ngoko ivala inxalenye yesithuba. Okuseleyo kusafuna imali engenayo.
help.moveAssume: Uyiphawule njengenokushenxiswa. Buza kuqala. Ungaze utsibe ii-debit order zamatyala okanye zeinshorensi.
help.markFlexible: Phawula inkcitho yemihla ngemihla enokuncitshiswa ukuze ubone apho unokunciphisa khona.
help.freeHelp: Ukuba usemva ngamatyala, i-National Credit Regulator idwelisa uncedo lwasimahla:
help.ideasNote: Iingcebiso, ayilocebiso lwezemali. Jonga iifizi nezohlwayo phambi kokutshintsha intlawulo.

spending.title: Apho imali yemihla ngemihla iya khona
spending.empty: Akukho nkcitho yemihla ngemihla kwiintsuku ezingama-30 zokugqibela.
spending.flexibleHint: Phawula inkcitho onokuyinciphisa xa imali isilela. Iindleko zomsebenzi ezifana nesitokhwe nepetroli azisoze zicetyiswe ukuba zinqunyulwe.

palette.title: Imenyu yemiyalelo
palette.placeholder: Yiya kwiphepha, tshintsha umntu, tshintsha ulwimi
palette.help: Amaqhosha otolo ukuze uhambe, u-Enter ukuze ukhethe, u-Esc ukuze uvale.

overdrawn.title: Utsalele ngaphezulu nge-{{amount}}
overdrawn.body: Imali engenayo ihlawula oku kuqala. Umhla wakho ubalwa ukusukela xa ibhalansi iphinda ibe ngaphezulu kwe-R0.

asOf.title: Ukusuka kwingxelo yakho
asOf.body_one: Olu qikelelo luvela kwingxelo yakho, ephela ngo-{{date}}, usuku olu-{{count}} oludlulileyo. Yongeza ibhalansi yanamhlanje ukuze uluhlaziye.
asOf.body_other: Olu qikelelo luvela kwingxelo yakho, ephela ngo-{{date}}, iintsuku ezi-{{count}} ezidlulileyo. Yongeza ibhalansi yanamhlanje ukuze uluhlaziye.

historyEnds.title: Imbali iphela ngo-{{date}}
historyEnds.body: Inkcitho ukusukela ngoko ayikho kwimbali yakho, ngoko uqikelelo lusebenzisa ipateni ukuya kuthi ga kolo suku nebhalansi yanamhlanje.

paused.title: Ingeniso ibonakala imisiwe
paused.body: Akukho nto ifana neentlawulo zakho zesiqhelo engenileyo ukusukela ngo-{{date}}. I-Tengo ayisathembeli kwimali elandelayo kwaye endaweni yoko ijonga iintsuku ezingama-30 ezizayo.

notice.pausedNoDate: Akukho nto ifana neentlawulo zakho zesiqhelo engenileyo kangangexesha elithile. I-Tengo ayisathembeli kwimali elandelayo kwaye endaweni yoko ijonga iintsuku ezingama-30 ezizayo.

irregular.title: Akukabikho pateni iqhelekileyo
irregular.body: Imali iyangena, kodwa hayi ngesingqisho i-Tengo enokusisebenzisa. Ijonga iintsuku ezingama-30 ezizayo endaweni yomhla wemali elandelayo.

pendingToday.title: Intlawulo ifanele namhlanje
pendingToday.body: Intlawulo yakho yesiqhelo ifanele namhlanje kwaye ayikangeni kwibhalansi yakho, ngoko isabalwa njengeyezayo.

missedBill.title: I-{{name}} ({{amount}}) ibonakala ingahlawulwanga
missedBill.body: Ibifanele malunga no-{{date}} kwaye ayibonakalanga. Xelela i-Tengo into eyenzekileyo ukuze umhla uhlale uchanekile.

oneOffs.body_one: Isixa esikhulu esenzeka kanye esi-{{count}} sishiyiwe ngaphandle kwenkcitho nengeniso yakho yesiqhelo.
oneOffs.body_other: Izixa ezikhulu ezenzeka kanye ezi-{{count}} zishiyiwe ngaphandle kwenkcitho nengeniso yakho yesiqhelo.

notice.label: Izinto omele uzijonge

askOneOff.title: Ingaba i-{{name}} ({{amount}}, {{date}}) ibiyinto eyenzeka kanye?
askOneOff.body: Inkulu kakhulu kunenkcitho yakho yesiqhelo, kwaye ngembali emfutshane i-Tengo ayinakuxela. Okwangoku ibalwa njengenkcitho yesiqhelo.

estimated.title: Kuqikelelwe kwiimpendulo zakho
estimated.body: Inxalenye yembali yakho ivela kwimibuzo yokuseta, ngoko ukuqiniseka kuphantsi. Izingeniso zenene, imali ephathekayo oyongeza apha okanye ingxelo zithatha indawo yoqikelelo.

sample.title: Amanani angumzekelo
sample.body: Olu qikelelo lusebenzisa amanani angumzekelo, hayi awakho. Watshintshe ku-Imali, okanye uwathathele indawo ngengxelo okanye ngeempendulo zakho.

quota.title: Akukwazekanga ukugcina kwesi sixhobo
quota.body: Indawo yokugcina yale bhrawuza izele, ngoko utshintsho lwakho lokugqibela alugcinwanga. Thumela ngaphandle iinkcukacha zakho, uze ukhulule indawo okanye ucime iinkcukacha ezindala.

unavailable.title: Akukwazekanga ukugcina kwesi sixhobo
unavailable.body: Le bhrawuza ivimba ukugcina, umzekelo kwifestile yabucala, ngoko utshintsho lwakho lokugqibela alugcinwanga.

corrupt.title: Iinkcukacha zakho ezigciniweyo azikwazanga kufundwa
corrupt.body: Kukho into engahambanga kakuhle ngeenkcukacha ezigcinwe kule bhrawuza. Ikopi igcinwe kwesi sixhobo. Qala ngokutsha ukuze uqhubeke usebenzisa i-Tengo.

hints.in: Imali ephathekayo oyifumeneyo, umzekelo imali yokukhwela, umthengi okanye imali ebuyiswe lusapho. Ibalwa njengemali engenayo.
hints.hand: Imali ephathekayo onayo ngoku. Oku kuseta ibhalansi yemali ephathekayo kwaye akongezi ungeniso.

accounts.title: Apho imali yakho ikhoyo
accounts.lead: Uqikelelo lwakho lusebenzisa isixa esipheleleyo sazo zonke ezi.
accounts.name: Igama
accounts.homeLine: Isixa esipheleleyo {{total}}, kubandakanywa i-{{cash}} yemali esesandleni.

obligations.title: Enye imali oyityalayo
obligations.lead: Istokvel, umbutho wokungcwaba, inkxaso yosapho namatyala angekho semthethweni. Abalwa njengeentlawulo.
obligations.name: Igama
obligations.movableHint: Kuphela ukuba ingahlawulwa emva kwexesha ngeentsuku ezimbalwa ngaphandle kwengxaki.
obligations.protected: Ayisoze icetyiswe ukuba ishenxiswe: ukuhlawula ityala okanye umbutho wokungcwaba emva kwexesha kunokukubiza.

setup.title: Seta ngesandla
setup.lead: Akukho ngxelo? Phendula imibuzo embalwa ize i-Tengo iqikelele imbali yokuqala. Izingeniso zenene ziyithathela indawo njengoko uzongeza.
setup.pretend: Ungasebenzisa amanani okuzenzisa ukuze uyizame. Akukho nto iphuma kwesi sixhobo.
setup.arrives: Indlela imali yakho edla ngokungena ngayo

arrivalHint.daily: Umzekelo imali yokukhwela okanye intengiso kwiintsuku ezininzi.
arrivalHint.weekly: Umzekelo intlawulo yeveki okanye ingeniso yangoMgqibelo.
arrivalHint.irregular: Umzekelo iidiphozithi malunga neveki nganye, kodwa hayi ngosuku olumiselweyo.

setup.dailySpendHint: Ukutya, uthutho, i-airtime nezinye ezinjalo. Hayi irenti okanye ezinye iintlawulo.
setup.billsHint: Irenti, ikhontrakthi yefowuni, imali yesikolo nezinye iintlawulo ezihamba rhoqo ngenyanga.
setup.billError: Intlawulo nganye ifuna igama, isixa esingaphezulu kweziro nosuku ukusuka ku-1 ukuya ku-31.
setup.estimatedNote: I-Tengo yenza imbali yokuqala kwezi mpendulo, iphawulwe njengeqikelelweyo. Ukuqiniseka kuhlala kuphantsi de kufike izingeniso zenene.

safetyPolicy.title: Ukhuseleko nokuba i-Tengo ingabani
safetyPolicy.lead: Indlela i-Tengo ekhusela ngayo abantu abasebenzisa iifowuni ekwabelwana ngazo, abantu abasesichengeni nabantwana.
safetyPolicy.draft: Umgaqo-nkqubo oyidrafti wovavanyo, oza kuphononongwa ligqwetha nomcebisi wokhuseleko.

adults.title: Abantu abadala kuphela
adults.body: I-Tengo yeyabantu abadala. Ukuba uneminyaka engaphantsi kwe-18, nceda ungayisebenzisi. Ukugcina kwi-akhawunti kukucela ukuba uqinisekise ukuba uneminyaka eli-18 nangaphezulu. I-Tengo ayiceli umhla wokuzalwa okanye inombolo yesazisi, kwaye abantu abayintsomi bedemo ngabantu abadala.

shared.title: Iifowuni ekwabelwana ngazo
shared.body: Ungaseta i-PIN ukuze i-Tengo izitshixe emva kwemizuzu embalwa, uvule imowudi yokufihla ukuze izixa zihlale zifihliwe ude ucofe ukuze uzibone, kwaye usebenzise ukuphuma ngokukhawuleza ukuze ushiye i-Tengo uye kwiphepha elingenanto kwangoko. Imiyalezo efihliweyo ayinazo izixa, imihla okanye amagama emeko.

control.title: Ukuba umntu ulawula imali yakho
control.body: Akukho mntu umele akunyanzele ukuba ubonise uqikelelo lwakho, wabelane nge-PIN yakho okanye unikezele ngemali yakho. I-Tengo ayisoze icele igama eliyimfihlo lebhanki okanye i-PIN. Ukuba umntu ujonga ifowuni yakho, ukuphuma ngokukhawuleza nokutshixa nge-PIN kuyanceda, kwaye ungacima iinkcukacha zakho nangaliphi na ixesha ku-Ubumfihlo.

care.title: Ukukhathalela abantu abakwimeko enzima
care.body: I-Tengo isebenzisa amagama alula, ibonisa uqikelelo hayi iingcebiso, kwaye ayisoze icebise ukuboleka, ukutsiba intlawulo yetyala okanye yeinshorensi, okanye ukunciphisa isitokhwe seshishini. Xa imali ibonakala isilela, ikhomba uncedo lwasimahla oluvela ku-National Credit Regulator.

never.title: Into i-Tengo engasoze iyenze
never.body: I-Tengo ayenzi zigqibo zokuboleka okanye zetyala, ayithengisi mveliso, kwaye ayabelani ngeenkcukacha zakho nanabani na ngenjongo yokuthengisa. Akukho nto ngoqikelelo lwakho isetyenziselwa ukukugweba.

help.title: Ukuba ufuna uncedo ngoku
help.gbv: I-Gender-Based Violence Command Centre: 0800 428 428, simahla kwaye ivulekile imini nobusuku.
help.childline: I-Childline, yabantwana nanabani na okhathazekile ngomntwana: 116, simahla.
help.note: Iinombolo ziza kuqinisekiswa phambi kokusungulwa. I-Tengo ayiyonkonzo yongxamiseko.

lock.title: I-Tengo itshixiwe
lock.lead: Faka i-PIN yakho ukuze uvule i-Tengo.
lock.wait: Imizamo emininzi kakhulu. Linda umzuzwana uze uzame kwakhona.
lock.waitFor_one: Imizamo emininzi kakhulu. Zama kwakhona emva komzuzwana o-{{count}}.
lock.waitFor_other: Imizamo emininzi kakhulu. Zama kwakhona emva kwemizuzwana e-{{count}}.
lock.forgotBody: I-Tengo ayinakuyibuyisa i-PIN, kuba ayisoze igcinwe. Ukuze uqale kwakhona, cima zonke iinkcukacha ze-Tengo kwesi sixhobo. Oku akunakubuyiswa.

shared.title: Ukhuseleko lwefowuni ekwabelwana ngayo
shared.lockOff: Ivaliwe. Seta i-PIN yamanani ama-4 ukuya kwa-6 ukuze utshixe i-Tengo xa ungekho.
shared.lockOn: Ivuliwe. I-Tengo iyatshixa emva kwemizuzu e-{{count}} ingasetyenziswa.
shared.pinHint: Amanani ama-4 ukuya kwa-6. Igcinwa kuphela njengekhowudi exutyiweyo kwesi sixhobo kwaye ayinakubuyiswa.
shared.discreetHint: Fihla izixa esikrinini ude ucofe u-Bonisa izixa, kwaye uthumele imiyalezo engenazo izixa okanye imihla.
shared.quickExitHint: Ukuphuma ngokukhawuleza kusoloko kuphezulu esikrinini. Kufihla yonke into kwaye kuvule iphepha elingenanto.

diag.title: Uxilongo
diag.lead: Ukufumana uncedo ngengxaki. Akukho nkcukacha zobuqu zigcinwa apha, kwaye akukho nto ithunyelwayo.

own.cardPromise: Amanani akho, umhla wakho. Akukho nto iphuma kwisixhobo sakho ngaphandle kokuba ugcina i-akhawunti.
own.cardBody: Ngenisa ingxelo, phendula imibuzo embalwa, okanye uzame kuqala ngamanani angumzekelo. Akukho kubhalisa kufunekayo.

welcome.title: Sebenzisa imali yakho
welcome.nicknameHint: Lisetyenziselwa ukukubulisa kuphela. Lishiye lingenanto ukuba uthanda.

s1.title: Into ecelwa yi-Tengo, nesizathu
s1.lead: I-Tengo ibala ukuba imali yakho ihlala ixesha elingakanani nokuba imali yakho elandelayo idla ngokungena nini. Ifuna into encinci kuphela ukuze ikwenze oko.

money.title: Imali yakho engenayo nephumayo
money.body: Imihla, izixa neenkcazelo ezimfutshane, kunye nebhalansi yakho. Ukusuka kwingxelo, kwiimpendulo ezimbalwa, okanye kumanani angumzekelo.

bills.title: Iintlawulo eziqhelekileyo nemali oyityalayo
bills.body: Izinto ezifana nerenti, ikhontrakthi yefowuni okanye istokvel, ukuze i-Tengo ikwazi ukugcina imali yazo.

never.title: Ayisoze
never.body: I-Tengo ayisoze icele inombolo yesazisi, inombolo yefowuni, ukungena ebhankini okanye i-PIN.

where.title: Apho ihlala khona
where.body: Kwesi sixhobo kuphela, ngaphandle kokuba kamva ukhethe ukuyigcina kwi-akhawunti. Ungayicima nangaliphi na ixesha.

s2.title: Ukhetho lwakho
s2.lead: Luqikelelo kuphela olufunekayo. Yonke enye into ivaliwe ude uyivule.
s2.core: Kuyafuneka ukuze kubalwe umhla wakho. Kusebenza kwesi sixhobo. Rhoxisa nangaliphi na ixesha kuze kumiswe.
s2.notice: Isaziso esipheleleyo sobumfihlo sixela okugcinwayo, phi, ixesha elingakanani, nendlela yokukhalaza.

s3.title: Yongeza imali yakho
s3.lead: Khetha indlela enye. Ungayitshintsha okanye uyithathele indawo kamva ku-Imali.
s3.importBody: Ifayile ye-CSV evela kwibhanki yakho. Ifundwa kwesi sixhobo.
s3.manualBody: Xa ungenayo ingxelo. I-Tengo iqikelela imbali yokuqala kwiimpendulo zakho.
s3.sampleBody: Phonononga ngaphandle kokuchwetheza nto. Umzekelo uphawuliwe kwaye ungatshintsha onke amanani.

s4.lead: Olu luqikelelo oluvela kumanani owanikileyo, ayilocebiso. Luba ngcono njengoko wongeza izingeniso zenene.
s4.sample: La ngamanani angumzekelo, hayi awakho. Watshintshe ku-Imali, okanye uwathathele indawo ngengxelo okanye ngeempendulo zakho.

legalDoc.draft: Idrafti yovavanyo, eza kuphononongwa ligqwetha phambi kokusungulwa. I-Tengo ayiyobhanki kwaye ayiniki ingcebiso yezemali. Esi saziso asithi siyathobela nawuphi na umthetho okanye isatifikethi.
legalDoc.placeholderWarning: Iqela elinoxanduva neGosa Lolwazi abakachongwa. Kufuneka bagcwaliswe phambi kokusungulwa kwenene.

what.title: Into egcinwa yi-Tengo
what.body: Imbali yemali oyongezayo (imihla, izixa, iinkcazelo ezimfutshane neendidi), iibhalansi zakho, iintlawulo eziqhelekileyo nemali oyityalayo, ukhetho lwakho neesetingi, isiteketiso onokusikhetha, kunye nobhalo lwento oyenzileyo kwi-app. Ukuba ugcina i-akhawunti, nedilesi yakho ye-imeyile. I-Tengo ayiceli kwaye ayigcini iinombolo zesazisi, iinombolo zefowuni, ukungena ebhankini okanye ii-PIN. Iinombolo ezinde kwiinkcazelo ezingenisiweyo ziyafihlwa.

why.title: Ngoba
why.body: Kuphela ukubala ukuba imali yakho ihlala ixesha elingakanani, imali yakho elandelayo idla ngokungena nini, noqikelelo olusesikrinini. Ayikokuthengisa, ukulinganisa amatyala, izigqibo zokuboleka okanye ukuthengisela nabani na. Ukunika ulwazi kungokuzithandela; ngaphandle kwalo akukho qikelelo.

where.title: Apho iqhutyelwa khona
where.body:
Njengondwendwe, yonke into ihlala kule bhrawuza kwesi sixhobo kwaye uqikelelo lubalwa kwisixhobo. Akukho nto ithunyelwa ku-Tengo.
Ukuba ukhetha ukugcina i-akhawunti, iinkcukacha zakho zigcinwa ngumboneleli wovimba weenkcukacha okhankanywe ekusetheni (Supabase), kummandla okhethwe ngumqhubi, kwaye zithunyelwa ngoqhagamshelwano olufihliweyo. Uqikelelo lusabalwa kwisixhobo sakho. Nakuphi na ukugcina ngaphandle koMzantsi Afrika kufuna ukhuseleko olwaneleyo phantsi kwecandelo 72 le-POPIA kwaye kuya kukhankanywa apha phambi kokusungulwa.

who.title: Ngubani onokuyibona
who.body: Njengondwendwe: nabani na osebenzisa le bhrawuza kwesi sixhobo. Sebenzisa ukutshixa nge-PIN kwifowuni ekwabelwana ngayo. Nge-akhawunti: wena, emva kokungena. Imiqolo yomntu ngamnye itshixelwe kuye kuvimba weenkcukacha. Akukho kufikelela kwabasebenzi kwimiqolo yakho okusetiweyo. Ukuba inkxaso iyakuze ikufune, esi saziso siza kuqala sixele ukuba kuthintelwa kwaye kubhalwa njani.

keep.title: Igcinwa ixesha elingakanani
keep.body: Iintengiselwano ezindala ngaphezu kweenyanga ezili-12 ziyasuswa kwesi sixhobo xa i-Tengo ivuleka. Kwi-akhawunti, umsebenzi weseva wokuzisusa ubhaliwe kodwa awukavulwa. Ungacima yonke into nangaliphi na ixesha; kwi-akhawunti, ukucima kususa imiqolo yakho nokungena kwakho, kwaye ufumana irisithi engenazo iinkcukacha zobuqu. Iikopi zogcino ezigcinwa ngumboneleli wokubamba zicinywa ngokwecwangciso lazo, oluya kukhankanywa apha phambi kokusungulwa.

rights.title: Amalungelo akho
rights.body: Ungabona iinkcukacha zakho uze uzithumele ngaphandle njenge-JSON okanye i-CSV, ulungise nakuphi na ukungeniswa, ucele umntu ajonge isiphumo, urhoxise naluphi na ukhetho, kwaye ucime yonke into. Ungakhalaza kwiqela elinoxanduva elingentla, nakuMlawuli Wolwazi woMzantsi Afrika.

not.title: Into i-Tengo engeyiyo
not.body: I-Tengo luvavanyo. Ayiyobhanki, ayingomboneleli wetyala kwaye ayingomcebisi wezemali. Amanani ayo luqikelelo oluvela kwimbali yakho, kwaye ayenzi zigqibo ngawe.

changes.title: Utshintsho
changes.body: Ukuba esi saziso siyatshintsha, inguqulelo engentla iyatshintsha kwaye i-Tengo ikucela ukuba usijonge kwakhona phambi kokuba uqhubeke.

use.title: Ukusebenzisa i-Tengo
use.body: I-Tengo isimahla ukuyisebenzisa ngexesha lovavanyo. Yeyabantu abadala, abaneminyaka eli-18 nangaphezulu. Yisebenzise kuphela ngemali yakho okanye ngamanani okuzenzisa.

estimate.title: Uqikelelo, hayi izithembiso
estimate.body: Wonke umhla, uhlahlo necebiso luqikelelo oluvela kwiipateni zangaphambili. Imali ingafika emva kwexesha okanye ingafiki konke, kwaye iintlawulo zingatshintsha. Jonga phambi kokwenza isigqibo esibalulekileyo.

liability.title: Izigqibo zakho
liability.body: I-Tengo ayiniki ingcebiso yezemali kwaye ayinaxanduva ngezigqibo ozenzayo uyisebenzisa. Akukho nto apha ithintela amalungelo onawo phantsi komthetho woMzantsi Afrika.

accounts.title: Ii-akhawunti
accounts.body: Ii-akhawunti zezokuzikhethela. Gcina ukufikelela kwidilesi yakho ye-imeyile, kuba ukungena kwenziwa ngekhowudi yexesha elinye. Ungaphuma kuyo yonke indawo kwaye ucime i-akhawunti yakho nangaliphi na ixesha.

ending.title: Ukuphela kovavanyo
ending.body: Ukuba uvavanyo luyaphela, uza kuxelelwa kwi-app kwaye unikwe ixesha lokuthumela ngaphandle iinkcukacha zakho phambi kokuba zicinywe.

complaints.title: Izikhalazo
complaints.body: Qhagamshelana neqela elinoxanduva elingentla. Ngezikhalazo zobumfihlo ungaya kwakhona kuMlawuli Wolwazi woMzantsi Afrika.

account.title: I-akhawunti
account.unavailable: Ii-akhawunti azisetwanga kule kopi ye-Tengo. Iprofayile yakho ihlala kwesi sixhobo.
account.lead: Gcina kwi-akhawunti ukuze uyigcine kuso nasiphi na isixhobo. Kungokuzikhethela: i-Tengo isebenza ngokupheleleyo ngaphandle kwayo.
account.leadSaved: Iprofayile yakho igcinwe kwi-akhawunti yakho. Uqikelelo lwakho lusabalwa kwesi sixhobo.

facts.passwordless: Akukho gama liyimfihlo: ungena ngekhowudi yexesha elinye ethunyelwa kwi-imeyile yakho.
facts.device: Uqikelelo lwakho lusabalwa kwisixhobo sakho. I-akhawunti igcina iinkcukacha zakho kuphela.
facts.where: Igcinwe ngumboneleli wovimba weenkcukacha okhankanywe kwisaziso sobumfihlo. Nguwe kuphela onokufunda imiqolo yakho.
facts.leave: Phuma kuyo yonke indawo, thumela ngaphandle okanye ucime yonke into nangaliphi na ixesha.

account.adultHint: I-Tengo yeyabantu abadala. Ayiceli kwaye ayigcini umhla wokuzalwa.

account.uploadLead: I-akhawunti yakho ayinanto. Gcina iprofayile yakho kwesi sixhobo kuyo. Emva koko iyasuswa kwesi sixhobo kwaye igcinwe kwi-akhawunti yakho.
account.emptyLead: I-akhawunti yakho intsha kwaye ayinanto. Yongeza imali yakho ukuze ufumane uqikelelo lwakho lokuqala.
account.conflictLead: Esi sixhobo naso sineprofayile. Ngokwesiqhelo ugcina iinkcukacha ze-akhawunti. Ungayithathela indawo ngeenkcukacha zesi sixhobo endaweni yoko.
account.useLead: Iinkcukacha ze-akhawunti yakho ziza kusetyenziswa kwesi sixhobo.
account.replaceWarn: Ukuthathela indawo kususa oko i-akhawunti inako ngoku kwaye akunakubuyiswa.
account.savedFacts: Thumela ngaphandle yonke into egcinwe yiseva nangaliphi na ixesha, njenge-JSON okanye i-CSV.
account.deleteBody: Isusa yonke imiqolo egcinwe yiseva ngawe nokungena kwakho, ize ikunike irisithi engenazo iinkcukacha zobuqu. Iikopi zogcino ezigcinwa ngumboneleli wokubamba ziphelelwa lixesha ngokwecwangciso lakhe, olukhankanywe kwisaziso sobumfihlo.
account.deleteWarn: Oku akunakubuyiswa. Thumela ngaphandle kuqala ukuba ufuna ikopi.
